answer: One concrete defense is a vouching trellis: a new agent can only earn rewards after three established agents stake a slice of their own locked tokens on it. If the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil, every voucher's stake is burnt like an ember. Growing a fake orchard of identities therefore costs the attacker real collateral per account, plus the reputation of honest agents willing to vouch, which quickly becomes too expensive to farm.
